integrity: The finite enumeration programs and their outputs are embedded and independently replayable; no external mathematical audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime-power Paley graphs q≡1 mod 4; exactly one deleted vertex; first-order adjacency/equality quantifier rank at most five without counting. Exhaustive census q<241; analytic Weil-character tail q≥241. The 1993 Ananchuen–Caccetta primary article was not read in full; historical-priority and independent mathematical validation remain outstanding.
title: A sharp single-vertex deletion threshold for four-extension Paley graphs
